These method cards cover the computational and certification paths exercised by calibration issues #124–#128.

## Reading map

- [Circuit simulation](circuit-sim/index.qmd) — State-vector and tensor-network simulation, contraction ordering, and Trotter workflows.
- [Density-matrix renormalization group](dmrg/index.qmd) — Variational tensor-network calculations and spectral-gap studies.
- [Full exact diagonalization](ed-full/index.qmd) — Small-system reference values and exact cross-checks.
- [Lanczos exact diagonalization](ed-lanczos/index.qmd) — Sparse extremal-eigenvalue calculations for larger validation instances.
- [PEPS and iPEPS](peps-ipeps/index.qmd) — Two-dimensional variational upper bounds.
- [SDP and moment-SOS bounds](sdp-nctssos/index.qmd) — Certified lower bounds for frustrated Hamiltonians.
- [TEBD](tebd/index.qmd) — Product-formula time evolution and Trotter-error experiments.
- [VMC and neural quantum states](vmc-nqs/index.qmd) — Variational optimization for the kagome and J1–J2 problems.
